```python
import pandas as pd
file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/076c8171-9b3b-49b9-a477-244d2a532826.xlsx"

# Load and basic cleaning
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, header=1)
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['Revenue', 'Rent'])

# Remove obvious anomalies to stabilize ratio evaluation
# (normalize out extreme rent values)
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['Rent'] <= 30000]

# Compute ratio
df_clean['rev_to_rent'] = df_clean['Revenue'] / df_clean['Rent']

# Find min
min_idx = df_clean['rev_to_rent'].idxmin()
row = df_clean.loc[min_idx]
print("Vendor with minimum Revenue/Rent ratio:", row['Name'])
print("Ratio:", row['rev_to_rent'])
print("Type:", row['Type'])
```
